Class JsonBindings

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.json.spi.JsonBindings
public final class JsonBindings extends Object
Reads the values that the code generated for JsonRecord types binds from strings, and checks the type of a JsonValue. Each method reads the next value, and throws a JsonMappingException at its position if it does not bind.
Since:
0.1.0
